actions.name: Smog
actions.description: The mech expels a miasma of foul gasses. For 1 minute, a space 60 ft. around the mech grants concealment from vision and scent. The smog moves to its current space at the end of each of its turns in that period.

actions.name: Discharge
actions.description: As smog, but it's an instantaneous burst in a 120 ft. cube around the mech that lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Medical Mist
actions.description: A mech with an Offgasser and a Medical Suite can combine the two to deliver any injectable substance to all creatures within 30 ft. as a full action. This takes three usages of a consumable.

description.value:
